name: thinking
title: Thinking
description: the agent's collapsible reasoning block. live dot pulses, done title is past tense.

files.content:
/** * Thinking * Naming Thinking. the agent's collapsible reasoning block. * Variant live: true | false. open: controlled by the user. * Token bg surface-2 (level: inset, no glow), radius sm, dot 8 brand-graphic, steps text-2 14px. the pulse stops under reduced motion. * Structure Summary (dot + title + chevron) + list of steps. lives inside a surface. never nests another surface. * Usage Rule while live the dot pulses and the title is present tense (생각하는 중이에요). when done the title is past tense * (25초 동안 생각했어요) and the dot stops. never bold or color the steps. */ import * as React from "react" import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" interface ThinkingProps extends React.DetailsHTMLAttributes { title: string live?: boolean steps: string[] } function Thinking({ title, live, steps, className, ...props }: ThinkingProps) { return (
{title}
    {steps.map((s, i) => (
  1. {s}
    2. ))}
) } export { Thinking }
